what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Tanzania, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2025, IDMC recorded 10945 new displacements by disasters inside Tanzania: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Tanzania list floods and storms.
UCDP records one armed conflict in Tanzania, with the Islamic State group in 2020.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, and the 2025 figure is the latest.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced above zero.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Tanzania.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
